messages:
claire: quick heads-up, bringing Tanager-lora-v1 into the gptx-7b-v2 int4 build for customer smoke tests. low-risk merge but seeing a numeric formatting regression in int4.
ryan: can you paste a short repro?
claire: simple repro below — FP16 output is correct, int4 sometimes loses decimal points or inserts extra zeros.
claire: repro: 
```
User: "Refund $12.50 to order ORD-9982"
Assistant:
```
claire: fp16 -> "Refunded $12.50 for ORD-9982". int4 -> "Refunded $1250 for ORD-9982" or sometimes "Refunded $12"
lee: hmm. that smells like either tokenizer id overlap around punctuation tokens or a quant scale blowup in some final linear layers. did tokenizer remap run after the adapter graft?
ryan: ran tokenmap-diff; found adapter introduced token aliases for "$"+digit combos that map to adjacent ids. also quant stats show per-channel scale outliers on feedforward layers 12 and 27.
claire: logs: 
```
2026-03-21T16:10:11Z WARN tokenmap: alias detected for token "$1" -> ids [502,1502]
2026-03-21T16:10:11Z DEBUG quant: layer12 scale stddev 0.42 > 0.2
```
lee: two-pronged plan: 1) apply an adapter-side alias normalization map when merging (canonicalize "$" token family), 2) try int4 quant with per-tensor clipping and symmetric quant instead of per-channel on the suspect layers to see sensitivity.
claire: agreed. i'll spin a quickpack for targeted numeric/currency cases (40 samples: currency, long ids, amounts with commas). run id qp-1812349999. command: 
```
./run_quickpack --model gptx-7b-v2-int4 --adapter Tanager-lora-v1 --samples 40 --metrics em,token-err,num-mse --out /tmp/qp-1812349999.json
```
ops-bot: Quickpack qp-1812349999 scheduled on runner-3. Estimated duration 5m.
ryan: while that's running, i'm pushing a small merge patch that adds normalizer map and pins quant config for layer12,27 (symmetric int4). branch: fix/tanager-token-alias. sha: e7a1f2.
lee: after patch, i re-ran quant locally. baseline int4 EM=0.89, TER=0.14, num-mse=0.032. with token-normalize + symmetric int4 on bad layers: EM=0.95, TER=0.04, num-mse=0.005.
claire: nice lift. any remaining failure modes?
lee: tail of long order ids (>=12 chars) still occasionally truncated — likely kv-cache length quant alignment. needs a short eval focusing on long-context alignment.
ryan: operational proposal: enable a fp16 Dedicated fallback for /payments/* route with canary 10% traffic for 24h while we run full validation. automatic rollback if EM drops below 0.985 or num-mse increases >2x relative to fp16 baseline.
claire: i'll notify customer (ETA ~48h full sign-off) and create rollout PR for eng-platform. tagging ops for Dedicated route config.
ops-bot: Route change ticket created: TICKET-7891. Assigned to eng-platform.
claire: saving quickpack artifact at /artifacts/qp-1812349999/summary.json and attaching the small token-normalize patch to the ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:
